name: Oriel
summary: Private, version-bound qualification and conditional access for autonomous agents.

functions.name: run-qualification
functions.summary: Run a tenant-private adversarial test against a target agent and persist a scoped result.

functions.name: get-qualification
functions.summary: Read the current qualification for one exact agent DID and version hash.

functions.name: protected-support-action
functions.summary: Return a protected synthetic support record only to the qualified caller and version.

functions.name: revoke-qualification
functions.summary: Tenant-owner revocation of a target agent qualification.
